description: Set a text layer's Source Text and formatting (Character and Paragraph panels) for the whole layer or a range of characters or paragraphs: font (by PostScript name, or family and style), size, fill and stroke, tracking, kerning, leading, scale, baseline shift and super/subscript, caps, ligatures, tsume, digits, indents, spacing, justification, composer, direction and orientation, step changes, and Reset Character/Paragraph. Applies at the current time if Source Text is animated

adjust.description: Step changes added to the current values, as the Character panel shortcuts do (negative to decrease)

baselineShift.description: Pixels to add to the baseline shift

fontSize.description: Pixels to add to the size

leading.description: Pixels to add to the leading

autoKerning.description: Metrics or Optical kerning, or none

baselineDirection.description: Vertical text: standard, rotated, or tate_chuu_yoko (Tate-Chuu-Yoko)

boxSize.description: Paragraph text: [width, height] of the box in pixels

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

digits.description: Digit set, e.g. hindi for Hindi Digits

fontFamily.description: Font family, with fontStyle, chosen through the font list (app.fonts)

kerning.description: Manual kerning, thousandths of an em

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

range.description: Format only part of the text. Character options on a paragraph range apply to its characters; paragraph options apply to whole paragraphs. Omit for the whole layer

end.description: 0-based index just after the last one

strokeOverFill.description: true: Stroke Over Fill; false: Fill Over Stroke

text.description: New text (with range: replaces the range); line breaks start new lines

tracking.description: Thousandths of an em; 0 resets tracking

universalTextEngine.description: true: switch the layer to the Universal Text Engine (cannot be switched back by script)

name: set_text
title: Set Text
